pages.text: Armors created using the Philosopher's Stone and Origin.
Head armor that can be created with the Origin of Faith. $(br)In addition to the buff that allows creative flight, it grants regeneration 3 and resistance 2.
Body armor that can be created with the Origin of Justice. $(br)Reflects 100% of the damage it would normally take and provides knockback and fire.
Leg armor that can be created with the Origin of Wisdom. $(br)It reduces movement speed due to blocking, nullifies slow debuffs, and reduces the reduction of satiety.
Boots that can be created with the Origin of Temperance. $(br)It nullifies fall damage and halves the duration of all debuffs.
